basic_profile.bio: A passionate forestry worker hailing from the Pacific Northwest, I've spent the last decade mastering the art of timber felling. When I'm not in the woods, you can find me folding intricate origami designs or catching up on the latest sports news. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel for work. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after a long day outdoors.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in forestry comes from years of hands-on experience combined with a degree in environmental science. I've spent countless hours learning from seasoned timber fallers and honing my skills with different types of axes. My knowledge also extends to crafting origami, a hobby I picked up in college to balance the physically demanding nature of my job.
